title: An update reports COMPLETED while rows or gateway flows are still missing

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: four engines, seven occurrences

symptom: Most cases show no error event. The destination was short after COMPLETED in seven occurrences across the engines; a second plain update completed five of them.
cause: Not established. The update may run ahead of the gateway's snapshot or flows.
effect: Row counts look complete in the update's status when they aren't.
fix: Count after the gateway's SNAPSHOT_COMPLETED events, not at COMPLETED; run the update again, then count again.
notes: Not all of these self-heal: a MySQL keyless table stayed short through two full refreshes. Causes seen: a lost PostgreSQL slot, removed Oracle archive logs, a SQL Server CPU governor limit.
